description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayer component in the Rialto client, specifically testing the creation and error handling of WebAudioPlayer objects using Google Test framework.

classes.name: RialtoClientCreateWebAudioPlayerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudioPlayer creation tests, inheriting from WebAudioPlayerTestBase.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Test that a WebAudioPlayer object can be created successfully.

methods.name: CreateWebAudioPlayerIpcFailure
methods.description: Test that creating a WebAudioPlayer throws an exception if createWebAudioPlayerIpc returns nullptr.

methods.name: CreateWebAudioPlayerRegisterFailure
methods.description: Test that creating a WebAudioPlayer throws an exception if registerClient fails.
